heading: Policy period and territory
text: This policy applies only to accidents and losses which occur during the policy period. The policy period begins at 12:01 a.m. local time on the effective date and ends at 12:01 a.m. local time on the expiration date shown in the Declarations.

heading: Coverage applies only where a premium is shown
text: Coverage is provided only for those coverages for which a premium is shown in the Declarations for the insured vehicle.

section: Part D: Damage to your auto
heading: Collision insuring agreement
text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision with another object or by upset, minus the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.

section: Part D: Damage to your auto
heading: Other than collision insuring agreement
text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including glass breakage, hail, fire and theft, minus the applicable deductible.

heading: Public or livery conveyance
text: We do not provide coverage for loss to your covered auto while it is being used to carry persons or property for a fee, including use through a ride-hailing application.

heading: Named driver exclusion
text: No coverage is provided for any claim arising from an accident or loss that occurs while your covered auto is being operated by a driver named as excluded in this endorsement.

heading: Bodily injury liability
text: We will pay damages for bodily injury for which an insured becomes legally responsible because of an auto accident. Bodily injury claims are handled by a licensed adjuster.

heading: Medical payments coverage
text: We will pay reasonable expenses for necessary medical services because of bodily injury sustained by an insured in an auto accident, up to the limit shown in the Declarations.

heading: Total loss settlement
text: Our limit of liability is the lesser of the actual cash value of the damaged property or the amount necessary to repair it. A vehicle may be declared a total loss when repair cost approaches its actual cash value.

section: Part E: Duties after an accident or loss
heading: Duties after loss
text: A person seeking coverage must promptly notify us of the loss and, in the event of theft, promptly notify the police. We may require these duties to be met before payment.

heading: Concealment or fraud
text: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has made fraudulent statements or engaged in fraudulent conduct in connection with any accident or loss for which coverage is sought.
